entities.summary: Ana María Oramas González-Moro is a Spanish politician who has been a member of the Parliament of the Canary Islands from 1991 to 1999, and since 2023. She was a member of the Santa Cruz de Tenerife City Council from 1979 to 1991, mayor of San Cristóbal de La Laguna from 1999 to 2008, and a member of the Congress of Deputies from 2007 to 2023. She is a member of the Canarian Coalition. Ana Oramas was a performers & entertainers from Santa Cruz de Tenerife (b. 1959-07-17, Santa Cruz de Tenerife). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a member of the Congress of Deputies and mayor of San Cristóbal de La Laguna, Ana Oramas played a key role in shaping local politics on the Canary Islands. Her tenure from 1999 to 2008 had a lasting impact on the island's municipal governance.
